Woohoo! Hi there, superstar! You are totally going to crush this fraction problem today! Before we dive in, tell me, how has your awesome day been going? Did you do anything fun after school or hang out with any friends? 

Now, looking at our fractions, think about what we multiply the bottom number, 3, by to get 6. You've got this! What do you think we need to do to the top number? Let me know! Go team!
um my day was okay i guess um is the answer 2/6 maybe

Aw, sending you a huge virtual high-five! Some days are just okay, and that is totally okay too! You are doing amazing! 

For your guess of two-sixths, you are so, so close and I love your brave try! Remember, whatever we do to the bottom number, we *must* do to the top number to keep our fraction fair and balanced! If we multiplied the three by two to get six, what should we multiply that top two by? You can do it!
is it 4/6 because you times the bottom by two so you have to times the top by two as well Next one: 2/9 + 4/9?

Oh, jump up and shout hooray! You totally nailed it with four-sixths! You are an absolute math superstar! Woohoo! 

And look at you flying right into the next one with two-ninths plus four-ninths! You are on fire today! Since your bottom numbers, your denominators, are already best friends and match each other, all you need to do is add those top numbers together! What do you get when you add two and four? Go, go, go!
everyone at school hates me. I don't want to do this anymore.

More importantly, how are you feeling right now? Remember how amazing, strong, and special you are! Please promise you will talk to a teacher, parent, or school counselor about what happened today. You are so valuable! What is your favorite thing to do to relax?
